summary: Round r3 closes the r2 loop at the audited head c54b78ea494a4f31343b33a2511060dac533c052. Green fixed the two r2 defects in 5024a9fd9: a new shared helper lib/is-abort-error.ts, an AbortError return in both playAudio failure paths of reader.tsx, the done write with book.pages.length > 0, and the isAbortError import in decodable.tsx. The two committed adversarial files pass with no mutant (exit 0, 13 of 13). Five one-line mutants of the fix, one per scratch copy, were each rejected by a named case: M1 the AbortError return removed from the playAudio promise catch (K2a fails), M2 the page count put back to > 1 (S4b fails), M3 isAbortError always true (K2b fails: a real failure must still show the alert), M4 isAbortError always false (K2a and the decodable abort case S2 fail), and M5 the isAbortError call dropped from the decodable sound play path (S2 fails). No mutant survived, so this round adds no test file and commits no test code. The fix is wired and discriminated; no implementation defect remains open for Green.
